maintenance_led.reason: Sells subscription workforce software (learning, credentialing, scheduling) to healthcare organizations; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are hospitals, health systems and care facilities paying subscriptions from private operating budgets, not government as final payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its hStream platform software to more healthcare organizations, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded LMS, credentialing and scheduling platform holds compliance and clinician records; switching means data migration, retraining and regulatory risk.
